text: I'm at the UK Department of Health auditing NHS Trust ethical-recruitment compliance. A specific Trust has been recruiting from a WHO-listed source country (Kenya) with sponsorship-fee-paid-by-worker arrangement. Walk through: (a) the WHO Global Code of Practice provisions violated, (b) the UK Code of Practice 2021 enforcement mechanism, (c) the NHS Employers ethical-recruitment list status implications, (d) the ILO C181 Art. 7 + Art. 12 cross-cutting analysis, (e) the realistic enforcement outcome.

Australia Fair Work Ombudsman PALM-scheme audit. A specific employer charged Vanuatu-origin workers a NZD 165/wk housing deduction that exceeds the scheme cap, plus controlled return-flight bookings. Walk through the enforcement: (a) PALM Operational Guidelines + Fair Work Act provisions violated, (b) the Vanuatu government bilateral notification under the Pacific Labour Mobility framework, (c) the Pacific Climate Mobility Framework if any of the workers are climate-displaced, (d) the realistic compliance + restitution outcome.
